name: Tears -Contact-
source:
People talk to each other. If you look closely, they only only talking about themselves without trying to hear what the other person is saying. People get desperate to be heard. But sometimes people can understand the other person. Listen to us speak, we'll show you.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人们彼此交谈。可如果仔细观察，就会发现他们只顾诉说自己，根本没有试着倾听对方。人人都迫切希望自己的声音能被听见。不过，有时人们也确实能够理解彼此。听我们说吧，我们会让你看见。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
